name: Slide Projector
description: Vintage slide projector style image slideshow with slides sliding in, a flickering light, floating dust motes, a caption and a slide counter inside a dark framed panel.
contents: Framed panel showing one image at a time
Caption with the image title and a two digit slide counter
Floating dust motes over the image
behavior: Auto advances through images on a timer with a slide and rotate transition
Initial blur fades out shortly after mount
Dust motes spawn at an interval and drift and fade out
Caption and counter are hidden below the md breakpoint
editableByProps: Images, alt text and caption titles
Slide timing, dust mote frequency and initial blur

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the slide in transition angle or distance
needsCodeEdit.where: transform style in the images.map block

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the flicker range or speed

fixed: Root fills the viewport height and centers its content. Override with className using an important modifier such as !h-auto.
Panel size is based on vmin units
